operational.description: If we fail to innovate and develop new products in a timely and cost-effective manner for our new and existing product categories, our business and operating results could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Short product life cycles, intense competition, rapidly changing technology and consumer demand

operational.description: If we do not successfully execute on our growth opportunities, or if our growth opportunities are more limited than we expect, our operating results and future growth could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Reliance on diversifying product portfolio and expanding into new categories

operational.description: We purchase key components and products from a limited number of sources, and our business and operating results could be adversely affected if supply were delayed or constrained or if there were shortages of required components
operational.rationale: Component shortages, extended lead times on semiconductors, single-source suppliers, COVID-19 pandemic impact

operational.description: Our principal manufacturing operations and third-party contract manufacturers are located in China and Southeast Asia, which exposes us to risks associated with doing business in that geographic area as well as potential tariffs, adverse trade regulations, adverse tax consequences and pressure to move or diversify our manufacturing locations
operational.rationale: 40% of production in Suzhou, China; labor costs; infrastructure; tariffs; geopolitical tensions; COVID-19

operational.description: If we do not successfully coordinate the worldwide manufacturing and distribution of our products, we could lose sales and our business and operating results could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Complex supply chain; last-minute quarterly orders; inventory management

operational.description: If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brands, or if our brands or reputation are damaged, our reputation, business and operating results could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Dependence on third parties; online reviews; negative publicity

operational.description: If we do not compete effectively, demand for our products could decline and our business and operating results could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Large well-financed competitors; price competition; convergence of computing and consumer electronics markets; Microsoft, Apple, Google, Amazon competitive advantages

operational.description: We rely on third parties to sell and distribute our products, and we rely on their information to manage our business. Disruption of our relationship with these channel partners, changes in or issues with their business practices, their failure to provide timely and accurate information, changes in distribution partners, practices or models, conflicts among our channels of distribution, or failure to build and scale our own sales force for certain product categories and enterprise channel partners could adversely affect our business, results of operations, operating cash flows and financial condition
operational.rationale: Concentration with Amazon (19% of gross sales), Ingram Micro (13%), TD Synnex (15%); no long-term commitments; enterprise sales force development

operational.description: If we do not accurately forecast market demand for our products, our business and operating results could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Volatile demand; short product cycles; macroeconomic uncertainty; distributor inventory practices

operational.description: Our business depends in part on access to third-party platforms or technologies, and if access thereto is withdrawn, denied, or is not available on terms acceptable to us, or if the platforms or technologies change without notice to us, our business and operating results could be adversely affected
operational.rationale: Dependence on Apple, Android, Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa; platform owners are competitors

operational.description: Our success largely depends on our ability to manage, hire, retain, integrate and motivate sufficient numbers of qualified personnel, including senior leadership. Our strategy and our ability to innovate, design and produce new products, sell products, maintain operating margins and control expenses depend on key personnel that may be difficult to replace
operational.rationale: Competitive recruiting for skilled engineers; leadership turnover; stock price volatility affecting equity incentives

operational.description: As we focus on growth opportunities, we are divesting or discontinuing non-strategic product categories, or pursuing strategic acquisitions and investments, which could have an adverse impact on our business
operational.rationale: Integration challenges; impairment charges; past unsuccessful acquisitions

operational.description: As we continue our efforts to lower our costs and improve our operational efficiency, we may not fully realize our goals
operational.rationale: Restructuring activities; labor regulations; third-party negotiations

operational.description: Product quality issues could adversely affect our reputation, business and operating results
operational.rationale: Defects in hardware and software; recalls; warranty claims; third-party components

market.description: Adverse global and regional economic and geopolitical conditions can materially adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition
market.rationale: Inflation; interest rates; currency fluctuations; low growth; Ukraine war; reduced consumer and enterprise spending; Russia sanctions

market.description: We conduct operations in a number of countries and have invested significantly in growing our sales and marketing activities in China, and the effect of business, legal and political risks associated with international operations could adversely affect us
market.rationale: China regulatory environment; intellectual property protection; currency controls; political instability; infrastructure gaps

market.description: Our financial performance is subject to risks associated with fluctuations in currency exchange rates
market.rationale: 51% of revenue in non-USD currencies; impact on margins and earnings; hedging limitations

market.description: Our operating results are difficult to predict and fluctuations in results may cause volatility in the price of our shares
market.rationale: Quarterly order timing; last-minute retail sales; macroeconomic volatility; currency impacts; acquisition activity

market.description: Our gross margins can vary significantly depending on multiple factors, which can result in unanticipated fluctuations in our operating results
market.rationale: Product mix; pricing; supply chain costs; tariffs; currency; geographic mix; competition

regulatory.description: Changes in trade policy and regulations in the United States and other countries, including changes in trade agreements and the imposition of tariffs and the resulting consequences, may have adverse impacts on our business, results of operations and financial condition
regulatory.rationale: US-China tariffs; manufacturing in Asia; uncertainty of trade policy; China Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law; retaliatory tariffs

regulatory.description: As a result of changes in tax laws, treaties, rulings, regulations or agreements, or their interpretation, of Switzerland or any other country in which we operate, the loss of a major tax dispute or a successful challenge to our operating structure, intercompany pricing policies or the taxable presence of our key subsidiaries in certain countries, or other factors, our effective income tax rates may increase, which could adversely affect our net income and cash flows
regulatory.rationale: Swiss TRAF implementation; multiple jurisdictions; tax audits; base erosion and profit shifting (BEPS); effective tax rate changes

regulatory.description: We are subject to risks related to our environmental, social and governance (ESG) activities and disclosures
regulatory.rationale: Climate change regulations; ESG reporting evolution; investor expectations; compliance complexity; carbon pricing

regulatory.description: As a company operating in many markets and jurisdictions, expanding into new growth categories, and engaging in acquisitions, and as a Swiss, dual-listed company, we are subject to risks associated with new, existing and potential future laws and regulations
regulatory.rationale: Dual listing obligations; Swiss Corporate Law changes; conflict minerals; modern slavery acts; energy efficiency regulations

cyber.description: Losses or unauthorized access to or releases of confidential information could adversely affect our business and result in significant reputational, financial and legal consequences
cyber.rationale: Remote work; complexity and sophistication of attacks; ransomware; data breaches; IT system critical functions

cyber.description: The collection, storage, transmission, use and distribution of personal data could give rise to liabilities and additional costs of operation as a result of laws, governmental regulation and risks of data breaches and security incidents
cyber.rationale: GDPR; CCPA; CPRA; fragmented global regulation; enforcement increasing; data transfer restrictions

intellectual_property.description: Claims by others that we infringe their proprietary technology could adversely affect our business
intellectual_property.rationale: Expansion into new product categories; patent litigation; patent holders without operating business

intellectual_property.description: We may be unable to protect our proprietary rights. Unauthorized use of our technology may result in the development of products that compete with our products
intellectual_property.rationale: Patent invalidation risks; trade secret protection; independent development by others; copying

financial.description: We cannot ensure that our share repurchase programs will be fully utilized or that it will enhance long-term shareholder value. Share repurchases may also increase the volatility of the trading price of our shares. We similarly cannot ensure that we will continue to increase our dividend payments or to pay dividends at all. Share repurchases and dividends diminish our cash reserves
financial.rationale: $1.5 billion authorization; $505.8M available; discretionary programs; cash reserve impacts

financial.description: We maintain cash and cash equivalents at financial institutions and are exposed to credit risk in the event of default by such financial institutions
financial.rationale: Bank failures; concentrations despite diversification policy; insurance limits

evidence.statement: We continue to extend our engineering capabilities into more advanced technologies such as software, apps, cloud, data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI) and some core building blocks of navigation and tracking in augmented reality (AR) or virtual reality (VR)
To improve our customers' experience and operate efficiently, we use technology to facilitate chatbot interactions, enable self-help and apply Artificial Intelligence to optimize support searches

ai_positioning.summary_fr: Logitech positionne l'IA comme une capacité technique intégrée dans ses produits et services, notamment pour améliorer l'expérience client via des chatbots et la recherche optimisée. L'IA est présentée comme un élément clé de l'évolution des capacités d'ingénierie aux côtés d'autres technologies avancées (cloud, machine learning, AR/VR), sans être le pivot stratégique principal.

medium_term_outlook.near_term_challenges: We expect these challenges to continue in the near-term
challenges_described: Current macroeconomic environment including interest rate fluctuations, inflation, foreign exchange movements and low economic growth in certain regions
Low consumer confidence and recent declines in enterprise spending leading to reduced demand for some products
Uncertainty in strategy and timing of enterprises' return-to-office impacting demand for Video Collaboration and Creativity & Productivity products
Timing of further development of business-to-business go-to-market capabilities

mitigation_strategies: Reduction in operating expenses as revenues have declined to maintain margins and size the business for the current market
Reduction in inventories to more appropriately align with demand
Continued investment in business-to-business direct sales channel to improve performance
Release of new products to increase value proposition of portfolio
